The Tenderer shall have completed within the last three (03) years: (a) at least one (01) software supply contract with a value not less than BDT 70,00,000 (Seventy Lakh); and (b) at least one (01) ITES-related contract valued at not less than BDT 25,00,000 (Twenty-Five Lakh), including conference room/laboratory design, furniture, interior works, networking equipment, switches, computers, printers, and related items. The Tenderer shall have completed, as a Prime Contractor, at least one (01) similar ITES contract within the last three (03) years with a value of not less than BDT 1,50,00,000 (One Crore Fifty Lakh) under any Government, Semi-Government, or Autonomous Organization of Bangladesh. The Tenderer shall submit audited financial statements for the last two (02) completed fiscal years and possess valid ABC and Supervisory Licenses, where applicable. The Tenderer shall submit at least one (01) NOA issued through the e-GP System demonstrating engagement in similar business activities for a minimum of five (05) years and at least two (02) NOAs for ongoing contracts. Joint Venture (JV) participation shall not be permitted. Valid Manufacturer’s Authorization Certificates (MAF) from the respective OEMs for Desktop Computers and Drones must be submitted. Brief Description of Goods and Related “Procurement of Software and Hardware for Database Storage and Management for Preparation of Chattogram Metropolitan Service : Master Plan Project”, Masterplan Unit(4th floor), Chattogram Development Authority(CDA), Kotwali, Chattogram.
